core_categories: Medical Equipment; Medical Devices; Healthcare Supplies; Surgical Products; Diagnostics; Infection Control; Long-Term Care Equipment; Veterinary Products
specialty_focus: The Stevens Company is a family-owned Canadian full-line distributor of medical equipment, devices, and healthcare supplies. It supplies hospitals, clinics, long-term care facilities, and veterinary practices, acting as a primary Canadian principal and authorized distributor for major international and domestic medical device manufacturers. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
